meta.title: El Karateka Programador | AI Code Audits and Software Development
meta.description: Your software works—but is it production-ready? AI-generated code audits, custom development, performance optimization and agentic software architecture.
meta.ogTitle: El Karateka Programador | Software Audits and Development
meta.ogDescription: Black-belt discipline for production software: technical audits, optimization, custom development and agentic architecture.

translations.Disponible para auditorías y proyectos d: Available for audits and development projects
translations.La IA acelera el desarrollo, pero tambié: AI speeds up development, but it can also hide technical debt, security flaws, and fragile architectures. I audit, fix, and rebuild AI-generated systems, MVPs, and complex platforms so your product can stand up to the real world.
translations.Especialidad en auditoría técnica, optim: Specializing in technical audits, optimization and performance, custom software development, technology workshops, and agentic software architecture.
translations.El software que funciona en producción n: Production-ready software isn't a matter of luck: it takes architecture, testing, and discipline. That's what I audit, optimize, and build.
translations.Soluciones técnicas directas para softwa: Practical technical solutions for software that must work in production, not just in a demo
translations.Revisión profunda de código generado con: In-depth review of AI-generated code: hidden technical debt, security flaws, and fragile architectures. You receive a prioritized report with a remediation plan.
translations.Evaluación de escalabilidad, mantenibili: An assessment of scalability, maintainability, and costs before you invest further. Learn the true state of your product and what to fix first.
translations.Software robusto desde el diseño: web, m: Robust software by design: web, mobile, and backend systems built with feature-first architecture and DDD to grow without a rewrite.
translations.Formación práctica para desarrolladores: Hands-on training for developers and teams: software development, architecture, best practices, and practical AI applications.
translations.Diagnóstico y corrección de cuellos de b: Find and fix bottlenecks in any system: latency, slow queries, and infrastructure costs. Faster and more cost-effective to run.
translations.Diseño de sistemas con agentes de IA: or: Design systems with AI agents: orchestration, QA automation, guardrails, and workflows where AI operates with control and traceability.
translations.Experiencia sólida en un amplio ecosiste: Solid experience across a wide range of technologies
translations.Soy Emmanuel, desarrollador de software: I'm Emmanuel, a software developer passionate about creating innovative technology solutions and training new talent in programming.
translations.Mi enfoque combina la disciplina del kar: My approach combines the discipline of karate with the precision of code. I take on every project with determination and guide every student toward technical excellence.
translations.Ya sea para un proyecto de desarrollo o: Whether you're planning a software project or starting your programming journey, I'm here to help you reach your goals.

translations.Trayectoria profesional y proyectos dest: Professional experience and selected projects in production
translations.Liderazgo técnico mobile para PriorityMa: Mobile technical leadership for PriorityMax (BLoC/Cubit, Clean Architecture + DDD, modularization, and build flavors); development and release of credit and subscription flows with REST APIs and RBAC; unit and widget tests; support for biweekly releases and production stabilization; and CI/CD with Fastlane for automated builds, signing, and deployment.
translations.Desarrollo de la app logística Long Haul: Developed the Long Haul logistics app in Flutter (iOS/Android) for field operations, stops, incidents, and backend sync; built fintech modules with transactional flows and service integrations while maintaining release quality; contributed to architecture patterns (BLoC/Cubit, modularization, and build flavors) and testing practices. Also developed an insurance web app with Java Liferay + Spring Framework, including quote modules and a cron job to migrate users from DB2 to Oracle.
translations.Construí y mantuve soluciones para e-com: Built and maintained e-commerce, e-learning, and fintech solutions with Angular, React, and Magento 2.x; developed Flutter mobile products for finance and online retail. Integrated apps with backend services (Spring Boot / Node.js) and SQL/NoSQL databases, implemented asynchronous architectures with Apache Kafka, Docker deployments, and API gateways, and managed infrastructure on AWS, Linode, and Heroku.
translations.Desarrollo de módulos custom para Magent: Developed custom modules for Magento 2.x, provided e-commerce support and maintenance, and configured servers and CDNs for deployment and operations.
translations.Implementación y mantenimiento de e-comm: Implemented and maintained Magento 2 e-commerce sites, developed PHP APIs for integrations, and provided technical support in Linux environments.
translations.Desarrollo y mantenimiento evolutivo de: Developed and maintained mobile and web applications for various clients, integrated RESTful APIs, and implemented e-commerce modules (including Magento 2).
translations.Liderazgo técnico y desarrollo móvil par: Technical leadership and mobile development for a national fintech product: DDD + BLoC/Cubit architecture, credit and subscription flows, backend integrations, and biweekly releases. Scaled to over 280K Android users and 6K+ iOS users.
translations.Plataforma móvil para gestión de crédito: Mobile platform for managing credit and personal loans.
translations.Suite fintech para créditos y préstamos: Fintech suite for credit and loans with a mobile app and web platform. Frontend-backend integration, role-based security, and live business operations.
translations.Implementación de módulos custom, mejora: Custom modules, checkout and catalog improvements, production support, and integrations for Magento 2.x stores serving clients across industries.
